[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
def implementation (lst: List Int) : Int :=
match lst with
| [] => 0
| h :: t =>
  if h % 2 = 1 && t.length % 2 = 1 then
    h + implementation (List.drop t.length (t))
  else
    implementation (List.drop 1 t)
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
unfold problem_spec
let result := implementation lst
use result
simp [result]
simp [implementation]
by_cases h_lst_empty: lst = []
-- if lst = [] then
simp [h_lst_empty]
by_cases h_lst_len_1: lst.length = 1
-- if lst.length = 1 then
simp [h_lst_len_1]
exact (impl lst = 0)
